exercises.title: 7. Transforme com Let's / Why don't we

items.prompt: We should discuss this. → ___ discuss this.
We should find a solution. → ___ find a solution.
items.hintAfterError: Nessa sugestão o verbo vem direto na forma base, sem 'to'.

items.prompt: We should listen to both sides. → ___ to both sides.
items.hintAfterError: Depois de Let's, o verbo vem na forma base — sem to e sem -ing.

items.prompt: We should take a short break. → ___ take a short break?
items.hintAfterError: Na pergunta, o auxiliar negativo vem antes do sujeito: Why + don't + we.

items.prompt: We should talk to HR about this. → Why don't we ___ to HR about this?
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'Why don't we' o verbo fica na forma base, sem 'to' e sem -ing.

items.prompt: We should sit down and have a conversation. → ___ sit down and have a conversation.
We should agree on next steps. → ___ on next steps?
items.hintAfterError: Pergunta: auxiliar negativo antes do sujeito, e o verbo na forma base.

items.prompt: We should give each other more time. → ___ give each other more time?
items.hintAfterError: São 3 palavras e a frase termina com ponto de interrogação: Why + auxiliar negativo + we.

items.prompt: We should focus on the problem, not the person. → Let's ___ on the problem, not the person.
